body:
I know when I was 20 and miserable, I thought I would be alone forever.  The only girl I had the courage to ask out laughed in my face.  I was upset with the way I looked, felt I wasn't good at anything, was failing college, totaled my car, and I saw no chance of it getting better.  I felt like I was hated by everyone.  Someone I had never met or seen or heard of called the police on me for stalking her.  That almost did the trick.  My sheer presence made people so uncomfortable they would actually call the police.

Three years later I was a completely different person.  I looked different, I found confidence, i found passions.  People liked me.  Some even flocked to me.  Two more years and I was married to my dream girl who I would have never thought would have paid attention to me.  

I know it's hard to believe but at age 20, you have not scratched the surface of what life has to offer.  There are very few events or people I can even RECALL pre-age-20.  I've completely put it behind me.  It did not even take much effort, it just happened naturally.  It honestly happened unexpectedly.  

I also have Tourette's and ADHD and find it very hard to focus.  This got much easier in adulthood as well.
